entry.author: Ministry for Ethnic Communities
entry.summary:
Ethnic Xchange is New Zealand’s premier ethnic business symposium series, designed to harness the economic power of diversity and turn evidence into action. 

Watch highlights from Ethnic Xchange 2025: Going for Growth - Expanding Ethnic Enterprises. 460 people, 2 humanoid robots, 4 panel sessions, 3 presentations, 3 breakout sessions and 2 speeches, and plenty of opportunities to network - this highlight video captures it all!
